label: Kind
help: What kind of alternative place it is.

label: Today
help: Still going: the place still does what made it alternative. Changed: it stands, but is now something else or has gone mainstream. Gone: only the site or a trace is left.

label: Years
help: When it was active in this story, e.g. 1968–1980 or since 1999.

label: Scene
help: Who it belonged to: punks, squatters, Provos, ravers, artists, the gay scene, students...

label: The alternative story
help: Shown as part of the description, after the place's own text: the alternative story where the shared text does not tell it.
